name: Authorise.Net CIM Manager
description: Provides a block form that creates Authorize.Net Customer Information Manager (CIM) customer payment profiles from entered card and billing details.
project_description: The AuthNet CIM Manager module facilitates smooth integration with the Authorize.Net Customer Information Manager (CIM) for Drupal websites. It ships a single front-end form (exposed as a block and a route) that collects a customer's credit-card and billing details and, on submit, calls the Authorize.Net PHP SDK to create a CustomerProfile with an attached CustomerPaymentProfile on the merchant's Authorize.Net account. A newly created payment profile is validated with the SDK's ValidateCustomerPaymentProfile call and, if validation fails, the just-created profile is deleted again. A settings form stores the Authorize.Net API login ID, transaction key and the target environment (development/sandbox or production). The module does not store the created profile IDs in Drupal, provides no listing/charge/delete UI, and depends on the authorizenet/authorizenet Composer package (installed automatically via Composer). Requires no additional Drupal modules.
